title: Happy sheep
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='wool' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cfd8e6'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='36' y='72' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <rect x='46' y='72' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <rect x='56' y='72' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <rect x='66' y='72' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='36' y='85' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#2a2d52'/>
  <rect x='46' y='85' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#2a2d52'/>
  <rect x='56' y='85' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#2a2d52'/>
  <rect x='66' y='85' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#2a2d52'/>
  <!-- wool body -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='52' r='13' fill='url(#wool)'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='50' r='15' fill='url(#wool)'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='53' r='13' fill='url(#wool)'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='64' r='13' fill='url(#wool)'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='64' r='13' fill='url(#wool)'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='58' r='16' fill='url(#wool)'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#f2b6c1'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='58' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#e89aa9' transform='rotate(-20 34 58)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='58' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#e89aa9' transform='rotate(20 66 58)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='61' r='2.6' fill='#2a2d52'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='61' r='2.6' fill='#2a2d52'/>
  <circle cx='45.8' cy='60.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55.8' cy='60.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='67' r='2.6' fill='#f78fb0' opacity='0.75'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='67' r='2.6' fill='#f78fb0' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 69 Q50 74 55 69' stroke='#2a2d52' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='1.8' ry='1.2' fill='#e87a95'/>
</svg>
